# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.title }} is a product manager and builder working on usage-based pricing, metering, billing, tax compliance and the economics of AI. He is a Senior Product Manager at Salesforce, building enterprise usage management in Revenue Cloud, and independently runs LookupTax and UsagePricing.

Key facts:
- Current role: Senior Product Manager, Salesforce (usage management, pooling and governance controls for enterprise usage-based selling).
- Previously: Chargebee (Principal PM for the usage-based billing platform; Staff PM for invoicing and global tax), PayU (partner APIs and developer experience), Housing.com (consumer mobile app), Industrybuying (catalogue, logistics, GST).
- Focus areas: usage-based pricing, metering, rating, invoicing, tax and e-invoicing compliance, outcome-based pricing, AI token costs.
- Education: B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, College of Engineering Trivandrum. MIT Global Startup Labs, 2013.
